text:
Morgan: Hey team — PR up for console/observability: dashboards + tracehook + metrics name fixes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-console/pull/8423 Can someone give a quick review? Need to merge before tomorrow's deploy window.
Alex: :eyes: I'll take a look in ~30m. Any E2E or migration notes?
Morgan: Thanks — small migration: backfill script included, but it's idempotent. Tests: unit + dashboard snapshot. CI currently failing on linter in one file.
Priya: I'll check traces and rule names. Also confirm the Prom rule change — is alert threshold staying the same?
Morgan: Yes threshold unchanged. The Prom rule tweak is just label normalization. See snippet:
```yaml
- alert: HighErrorRate
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[5m])) by (service) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (service) > 0.05
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "High 5xx error rate for {{ $labels.service }}"
```
Sam: Quick nit in metrics naming in src/metrics.ts — missing export. Happy to push fix once approved. :+1: 
Alex: Found the linter error — trailing comma in dashboard config. Pushing a tiny commit.
ci-bot: CI update: build #8423.2 succeeded, e2e failed on nightly flake 'dashboard-renderer timeout' — rerunning.
Priya: Traces look good, trace_hook tag added correctly. :shipit: pending Alex's fix and CI green.
Morgan: Thanks! If CI green can someone merge and schedule the canary for 9am UTC tomorrow?
Sam: I can merge and start canary if no objections. Will hold off until CI is green and Alex's commit landed.
Alex: Committed fix. CI rerun started. :thumbsup: 
ci-bot: CI update: all checks passed. build #8423.3
Sam: Merging now and kicking off canary. Link to deploy task: https://app.redwood/devops/tasks/5991 — will report back in ~15m.
Morgan: Awesome thanks team! :tada:
